title: MCP editor-driving proof (screenshot or asset query) never recorded, though the AC requires it proven
evidence:
docs/agent-playbook.md: "## Proven agent commands (this machine, 2026-08-20)

```bash
npx -y ue-mcp --help        # boots the server: 27 tools + 1615 flow tasks,
                            # wraps the 830-tool Epic 5.8 registry snapshot
```

Editor-gated (record on the first editor run, then paste results here):

- Asset query (works editor-closed): `project.get_status`,
  `asset.list`/`asset.query` categories.
- Screenshot loop (the harness T2 equivalent):" — plus docs/project-context.md:91: "- [x] MCP wiring (community server verified booting) + official plugin"
detail: Acceptance says "an agent command can drive the editor (screenshot or asset query proven in the PR body)". The repo's own record proves only server boot; editor-driving results were never pasted, despite engine gates running 2026-08-20 (docs/timings.md).
recommended_fix: Run one UE-MCP asset query or editor.capture_screenshot against the now-installed engine, verify via bin/vision-read, and paste the recorded result into the playbook and PR body.

title: Gate 1 records PASS when clang-format is absent — self-skip exit 0 becomes a false green
evidence:
scripts/format-check.sh:21-24: "if [ -z "$FMT" ]; then
  echo "SKIP: no clang-format found (engine not installed yet) — format gate deferred"
  exit 0
fi" — with scripts/local-ci.sh:58: "  "Format (clang-format --dry-run on Source/)|scripts/format-check.sh"" and scripts/local-ci.sh:83-84: "    elif bash -c "$cmd"; then
      echo "   ✅ PASS""
detail: AGENTS.md gate discipline: "Gate scripts must not false-green: missing binaries fail loudly". A missing clang-format makes gate 1 exit 0, so run_gates logs "✅ PASS" and docs/timings.md records PASS for an unchecked format gate (earlier timings rows correctly showed SKIP).
recommended_fix: Make format-check.sh signal skip distinctly (e.g. exit 3), and have local-ci.sh map that to the SKIP outcome like ENGINE: gates — never PASS without checking.
